speaker: hero
text: Bit, why does my AI always sound like a *robot*?

speaker: bit
text: Because you ask like everyone *else*.

speaker: bit
text: Everyone types: write me a viral video.

speaker: bit
text: So everyone gets the *same* boring script.

speaker: hero
text: Okay. So how do I ask *right*?

speaker: bit
text: Two messages. Not *one*.

speaker: bit
text: Message one. Tell me your *topic*.

speaker: bit
text: Ask for ten problems people really *worry about*.

speaker: bit
text: And for each one, a question you can't *scroll past*.

speaker: hero
text: Ten questions. So I make ten *videos*?

speaker: bit
text: No. Message *two*.

speaker: bit
text: Pick the strongest question. Ask for a thirty-second *script*.

speaker: bit
text: First line *hooks*. Then simple words. Then a question for the *comments*.

speaker: hero
text: Script's ready. Can I post it?

speaker: bit
text: Not yet. First check: do videos on this question already get *views*?

speaker: hero
text: And if nobody made one?

speaker: bit
text: Then take the *next* question. You still have nine.

speaker: hero
text: All that for *one* video?

speaker: bit
text: For one video people actually *watch*.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
